enforced.pageSpecColorTokens: PageSpec colorToken fields accept only catalog paths listed in schema enums (thumb + source-dot sets); checked by schema enum + semantic_validate COLOR_TOKEN_IN_CATALOG + verify_all enum-subset check.
enforced.noRawValuesInPageSpec: PageSpec has no free-form style field; every visual value is owned by section/component contracts.
enforced.restrictedTokens: Tokens flagged restricted=reference-reconstruction-only (color.third-party-brand.*) must not be referenced by generated pages or new components.

convention.aliasOverRaw: New components reference semantic.* or component.* aliases, never raw hex.

rawValueRestrictions.elevation: use elevation.* only; the page has no other shadows

overrides.note: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance token-override field (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). The only token references in a PageSpec are colorToken on CSS colour-block thumbnails and source dots, closed by schema enum.

copyBudgetFormula: x-maxWords = realMaxWords + max(1, ceil(realMaxWords * 0.25)), realMaxWords measured from the site's own copy (example.pagespec.json).
cardinalityPolicy: Array lengths (nav links 3, FAQ items 6, saving steps 3, funnel tags 12, mockup cards 4, palette chips 3, palette hits hero 3 / finding 2) are locked to the observed counts. Changing them is a design-review decision, not a generator decision.
excludedDeadUtilities: #f3e7dc: compiled into index.C1emElDY.css as .bg-[#f3e7dc] but 0 DOM uses in the snapshot; not tokenised.
clamp(2rem,6.5vw,3.75rem): compiled utility with 0 DOM uses; not tokenised.
